comparison.objective: Assemble a two-part hook tool and use it to pull a cartridge from a hood; candidate commissions and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-part assembly, hook engagement, constrained pulling and extraction versus hex-key seating, collar turning, counterholding and dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Tool assembled and cartridge extracted without loss or damage versus two safe repeatable stops with retained adjustment. Candidate dynamic thresholds are incomplete.
comparison.reason: Extraction with a newly assembled hook tests engagement and tensile manipulation, not response-based adjustment.
